script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: Hustle on the Court

INT. GYM - DAY

Coach CARTER (40s, intense, driven) stands before his team, a group of five TEENAGERS, gathered on the basketball court.

CARTER
(looking around the room)
We've got three weeks to transform this team into a real contender. No excuses, no shortcuts. I want commitment, heart, and grit.

INT. GYM - LATER

Newcomer KALEN (16, shy, quiet) arrives, hesitant and uncertain. Carter notices and approaches him.

CARTER
(encouragingly)
You new? Name's Carter.

KALEN
(nervously)
Hi, Coach. I'm Kalen.

CARTER
(smiling)
Good. You're going to fit right in here.

INT. LIBRARY - NIGHT

Kalen studies the team's game footage, struggling to understand the intricacies of basketball strategy. He looks up and notices ANGELA (17, determined, focused), another team member, also studying.

ANGELA
(smiling)
Hey, Kalen. I'm Angela.

KALEN
(startled)
Hi, Angela.

They share an awkward moment before Angela breaks the silence.

ANGELA
This game can be frustrating, but don't give up. I believe in you.

INT. GYM - DAY

Carter pushes his team through rigorous drills, encouraging and supporting them. Kalen and Angela form a bond, relying on each other for encouragement.

INT. CAFETERIA - DAY

The team gathers for lunch. Kalen sits nervously at the table, unsure of his place among the more experienced players. Angela approaches him.

ANGELA
(cheerfully)
Sit down, Kalen. You're part of the team now.

INT. GYM - NIGHT

Carter puts the team through a grueling practice session. The players are exhausted and disheartened, but they push through, driven by their determination to succeed.

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

Kalen and Angela attend a school assembly. As they watch their classmates, they share a quiet moment of reflection on their journey so far.

KALEN
(whispering)
We're really doing this, aren't we?

ANGELA
(smiling)
Yes, we are.

INT. GYM - DAY

The team's first game arrives. Nervous but determined, they take to the court. Despite early struggles, they find their rhythm and start to pull ahead.

INT. GYM - LATER

The game ends in a thrilling victory for the team. Kalen and Angela embrace, their bond growing stronger.

ANGELA
(excitedly)
We did it!

KALEN
(smiling)
We sure did.

INT. GYM - NIGHT

Carter watches as his team celebrates their victory. He looks around at the group, proud of their progress and the friendships that have formed.

CARTER
(satisfied)
That's the spirit. Keep hustling.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
